svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hub: 60 round, 110 long, bored 31 for the 30 mm pivot pin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arm: 20 mm plate, cut to the outline in the front view: from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hub, 40 wide, down to an elbow 179 away, then 30 wide up to a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: round nose of 15 radius. Nose top 160 from the pivot centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 80 below it and 139 toward the press. Weld on the hub centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Socket: 72 x 5 tube, 228 long, on the hub on the far side,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 30 degrees above the line from the pivot to the nose.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: hub between the eject posts on the pin, circlips each end;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the nose sits under the push rod's foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Smooth the nose; it slides on the rod foot as it lifts 160.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: swings freely; with the lever in the socket, a pull lifts

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the nose 160 without touching the column or the mold.
